name: Immich
short_description: High performance self-hosted photo and video backup solution with mobile app support.
description: Immich is a very high performance, self-hosted photo and video backup solution directly from your mobile phone. It is meant to be a privacy-friendly alternative to Google Photos or Apple Photos with support for facial recognition, object detection, and shared albums.
usecases: Backup photos automatically from mobile devices.
Detect faces and objects in photos offline.
